method: Each entry records a source URL that was opened with fetch_page in this pass, the exact model and field checked, the quoted evidence from that page, and the decision. CONFIRMED entries change a provenance status from CITED_IN_NOTES_UNCHECKED to MANUFACTURER_VERIFIED with the same source URL. A field is left unchanged when the opened page does not state it explicitly. Fetch failures are recorded as INACCESSIBLE and change nothing.

Architectural specifications: 'three direct-radiator transducers'; components are a 12" low-frequency driver, a 5" midrange and a third high-frequency direct radiator. The document is the JBL manual, hosted by the Library of Congress; the existing sensitivity and impedance fields already cite this URL as manufacturer-issued.

The manual describes 'a frequency dividing network' and a tube-ported enclosure, but never states the word passive or describes onboard amplification. Passive is implied, not stated; left CITED_IN_NOTES_UNCHECKED.
fetch_page returned 'Failed to fetch page' on two attempts. Whether the document is manufacturer-issued is not established; sourceType stays as it is and the item remains an owner-input item.

The same manual gives 61 dB at 20 kHz in the Amplitude & Phase table and 92 dB fundamental at 20 kHz in the Acoustic Contribution table. No evidence selects one value, so the 20 kHz point is removed from the stored series and both values are kept in pointsContext. The simulator extrapolates above the last stored point; owner review is required.
